stem: The random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(1.5)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the sum of three independent values of $X$ is between 3 and 5 inclusive.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The sum of a large number, $n$, of values of $X$ is denoted by $T$. Using a suitable approximation, it was found that $\text{P}(T > 330) = 0.0391$, correct to 3 significant figures.

Find the value of $n$.
